## Description

A clear and concise description of the enhancement or feature request.

## Component

What part of the SDK should this enhance? (e.g., `escrow`, `wallet`, `auth`, `contract`, `tx-pipeline`, `utils`)

## Motivation

Why is this enhancement needed? What problem does it solve?

## Proposed Solution

How should this be implemented? What changes to the API are needed?

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Acceptance criterion 1
- [ ] Acceptance criterion 2
- [ ] Acceptance criterion 3

## Difficulty

How hard is this to implement? 🟢 Easy, 🟡 Medium, 🔴 Hard

## Estimated Time

Rough estimate of time to implement (e.g., 2-3 hours, 1 day, 1 week)

## Additional Context

Any other context, designs, or mockups?
